mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by quarter-over-quarter percent change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day SPX returns occur in < 55% of quarters with accelerating GDP growth, or the mechanism's Rank IC falls below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative 20-day SPX returns occur in < 60% of instances when the unemployment rate rises sharply, or the mechanism's Rank IC falls below 0.04 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows markedly, defined as the year-over-year percent change falling below 2%, it signals supply constraints that will pressure margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism generates negative 60-day SPX returns in < 55% of months with slowing industrial production growth, or its Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative 20-day SPX returns occur in < 60% of instances when the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, or the mechanism's Rank IC falls below 0.04 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both real estate loan balances and housing starts are rising, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism generates positive 60-day SPX returns in < 60% of months when both real estate loans and housing starts are rising, or its Rank IC falls below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth accelerates, defined as the 3-month moving average rising by more than 200,000 jobs, it signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day SPX returns occur in < 60% of instances when payroll employment growth accelerates, or the mechanism's Rank IC falls below 0.04 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index is rising faster than the federal funds rate, it signals that monetary policy is becoming accommodative and will boost economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism generates positive 60-day SPX returns in < 55% of months when CPI is rising faster than the federal funds rate, or its Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth is slowing and the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a weakening economy that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative 20-day SPX returns occur in < 60% of months when industrial production growth is slowing and unemployment is rising, or the mechanism's Rank IC falls below 0.04 in any 3-year rolling window.
